stem.en: If you have a large sample of a radioactive isotope versus a small sample of the same isotope, how do their half-lives compare?
stem.et: Kui teil on suur proov radioaktiivsest isotoobist ja väike proov samast isotoobist, kuidas on nende poolestusajad omavahel seotud?

label.en: The large sample has a longer half-life
The half-life is the same for both
The small sample has a longer half-life
Half-life cannot be defined for small samples
label.et: Poolestusaega ei saa väikeste proovide jaoks määratleda
